description: Source code for MySQL Record Manager class implementing record management functionalities such as schema creation, key listing, existence checks, updates, and deletions, with integration to TypeORM and MySQL.

classes.name: MySQLRecordManager_RecordManager
classes.description: Implements the INode interface; manages MySQL connection parameters and initialization.

classes.name: MySQLRecordManager
classes.description: Handles schema creation, data source connection, key existence checks, listing, updating, and deleting records in MySQL.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the record manager with credentials and configuration, returning an instance of MySQLRecordManager.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates the table name to prevent SQL injection and ensure proper format.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Creates and initializes a TypeORM DataSource for MySQL connection.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates the necessary table and indexes in MySQL if they do not exist.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current UNIX timestamp from the MySQL database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Upserts records into the MySQL table, handling both new and existing records.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if given keys exist in the database, returning a boolean array.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists keys based on optional filters like time, group IDs, and document ID.

methods.name: deleteKeys
methods.description: Deletes specified keys from the database.
